tools.description: The user wants the official practice participation or injury designations for a week (e.g. '2026 Week 3 injury report', 'Falcons practice report'). Defaults to the current league week.
Who is hurt before setting a lineup.
The user asks what games are on in a week, when a club plays, or the scores of a past week.
The user asks who leads a division, a club's record, or playoff clinches for a given week.
Follow up on a player id from injury_report or team_roster.

One GitHub Advisory Database record by GHSA id, CVE id or github.com/advisories URL: type (reviewed, unreviewed or malware), severity, CVSS v3 and v4, the EPSS exploit probability and percentile, CWE ids with names, every affected package with its vulnerable range, first patched version and vulnerable functions, credits (finder, reporter, remediation developer ...), references, the markdown description, and the GitHub review, NVD publication and withdrawal dates. Adds over osv-dev vuln and nvd-nist-gov cve: EPSS, CWE names, credit roles, the advisory type and vulnerable functions in one record. A CVE shared by several GHSA records returns the reviewed one and lists the rest. An unknown id is not_found. CC BY 4.0, attribute GitHub.

One page of a repository's contributors ordered by commit count on the default branch, with login, account type and contribution count. Anonymous (email-only) contributors are not listed. GitHub refuses this listing for repositories with very large histories (for example torvalds/linux), which surfaces as an error naming the reason.

The text of one file in a public GitHub repository at a branch, tag or commit, given as a raw.githubusercontent.com URL, a github.com blob URL, or repo plus path (ref defaults to HEAD, the default branch). One ranged GET to raw.githubusercontent.com, which does not use the REST API's 60/hour quota. Returns at most the first 1 MiB: size_bytes is the full size and truncated marks a cut file, reported as partial. A binary or non-UTF-8 file fails with invalid_input (not_text); a missing file, ref or repository is not_found.

Exact issue counts for a repository (pull requests excluded, unlike the repository's open_issues_count): the total for the given state plus one count per requested label, from GitHub's issue search. Makes 1 + labels.length search requests; at most 5 labels per call because GitHub allows 10 keyless searches per minute per IP.

One page of a repository's issues filtered by state and labels (all given labels must match), sorted by created/updated/comments. Pull requests are excluded unless include_pull_requests is true, so a page may hold fewer than per_page records; pull_requests_excluded says how many were dropped. Each record carries title, state, labels, assignees, milestone, comment and reaction counts, body and timestamps.

# Load Injury Reports
Source: [`R/load_injuries.R`](https://github.com/nflverse/nflreadr/blob/main/R/load_injuries.R)

`load_injuries.Rd`

## Usage [anchor](https://nflreadr.nflverse.com/reference/load_injuries.html#ref-usage)
```
load_injuries(
  seasons = most_recent_season(),
  file_type = getOption("nflreadr.prefer", default = "rds")
)
```
